title: Session views and actions
sqlTemplate: select _timestamp, session_id, view_id, type, view_url, view_loading_type, action_type, action_target_name, action_loading_time, service, env, version from _rumdata where session_id = {{session_id}} and type in ('view', 'action') order by _timestamp asc limit 100
emptyDataSemantics: No matching records -> an empty result set (zero rows), not an error.
